findings.claim: In retail v97, 0045CBE0 writes a transient per-section render record with source world-object pointer at +08, material name at +0C, draw flags at +20, depth-plane information at +30..3C, depth child links +40/+44, and variable 24-byte corner entries beginning +48. The primary and secondary world-object passes both call this producer for selected geometry children.
findings.limitations: Original static instruction/decompilation cross-check; no complete retail draw frame or ownership/liveness proof for scratch records.

findings.claim: Native 0044A0B0 traverses the per-owner slot list; for a clean low-flag slot, it calls the VQM release helper, clears slot+0x34, and marks flag bit 1 in slot+0x3C while retaining the slot+0x30 TMT descriptor pointer. In all tested cases it also invokes the M16 release boundary per slot.
findings.limitations: Five original-code synthetic-memory scenarios; VQM and M16 release implementations intercepted. Does not prove complete physical release or lifetime.

findings.claim: In one emulated state, original 0044A290 returns a previously cached owner-slot VQM pointer, original 0044A0B0 invalidates it, and a subsequent original 0044A290 call reloads via its 004474B0 service boundary and caches the new pointer. A third lookup reuses it. The TMT descriptor pointer remains stable.
findings.limitations: Real VQM loader 004474B0, CRT compare and release helpers substituted; synthetic owner slots, not v2.4 native vehicle session. No decoded pixel output.

findings.claim: Original 0045CB80 follows a plane comparison and writes either depth-tree child link +0x40 or +0x44; synthetic candidate positions of opposite sign took opposite branches at 24 executed original instructions apiece.
findings.limitations: Ghidra emitted uninitialized x87 ST-register warnings. Branch and link outcomes observed; exact floating-point behavior in retail gameplay is not independently validated.

findings.claim: Retail world-object rendering resolves owner/slot textures at 0044A290 and calls 00471FD0 for polygon submission; that routine uses special point/line paths and indirect raster clip and submission tables at 004F9538 and 004F8D38 for larger primitives. Original 004474B0 contains a VQM/CBK decode route with MAP fallback; 00471980 is a separate M16 lookup route.
findings.limitations: These downstream resource and raster paths were inspected statically; no actual VQM/CBK bytes were decoded or polygon callbacks executed in this checkpoint.

findings.claim: The v2.4 original-code GTSi/bus GEO and TMT construction has not yet been executed together with an original 0045CBE0 per-section record and an actual 00471FD0 raster callback in one persistent original-code vehicle state.
findings.limitations: Requires real vehicle graph, renderer context, scene/light data, resource pixel provider and callback setup; no full original retail Windows rendering claimed.
